page_title: LUT 1-1 WOL | Luton v Wolves 23/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' The corner is swung in but Luton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+7' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Cauley Woodrow (Luton) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Luton.
90+6' Mario Lemina (Wolves) gets a yellow card. The referee Joshua Smith made the right call.
90+5' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
90+3' Cauley Woodrow (Luton) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
90+3' Pedro Neto (Wolves) is able to continue to play.
90+1' Pedro Neto (Wolves) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Gary O'Neil has decided to make a change. Thomas Doyle (Wolves) replaces Joao Gomes.
90' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.

88' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Tom Lockyer (Luton). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.

86' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
86' Luton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Elijah Adebayo (Luton) will replace Issa Kabore.
84' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Issa Kabore (Luton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Corner kick. Luton will have an opportunity.
84' Gary O'Neil has decided to substitute Nelson Semedo and he is replaced by Hugo Bueno (Wolves).
83' Joao Gomes (Wolves) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
81' The resulting set piece from Luton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
80' Joshua Smith blows his whistle. Nelson Semedo (Wolves) commits a foul after dangerous play.
77' It could have been a good chance to score! Joao Gomes (Wolves) fails to release Nelson Semedo with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
76' Matt Doherty (Wolves) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
72' Rob Edwards decides to make a substitution. Jacob Brown will be replaced by Cauley Woodrow (Luton).
72' The substitution has been made. Ryan Giles (Luton) has replaced Alfie Doughty.
71' Boubacar Traore (Wolves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Matheus Cunha.
70' The corner is swung in but Luton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

69' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) fires the ball towards the right side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Luton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
68' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Luton comes to nothing.
65' 1 - 1 Goal! Carlton Morris (Luton) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Jose Sa into the bottom left corner.
65' Carlton Morris (Luton) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
65' Referee Joshua Smith is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Luton!
64' Referee Joshua Smith makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Luton. Let’s see what happens!
63' Joao Gomes (Wolves) handles the ball inside the penalty area. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Luton.
61' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jose Sa, who smothers the ball.
60' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.

58' Max Kilman (Wolves) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball low towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Thomas Kaminski, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
57' That's the end of the game for Albert Sambi Lokonga, who is replaced by Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton).
54' The resulting corner, taken by Albert Sambi Lokonga (Luton), comes to nothing.
52' Issa Kabore (Luton) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
50' 0 - 1 Goal! Pedro Neto (Wolves) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top right corner. He makes it 0:1.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Rayan Ait Nouri is replaced by Matt Doherty (Wolves).
46' Gary O'Neil makes a switch. Toti is coming on in place of Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Luton) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
45+4' Jacob Brown (Luton) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Luton.
45+4' Pedro Neto (Wolves) commits a foul during an attacking move.
45+3' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Luton) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Jose Sa and he's equal to it.
45+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joao Gomes (Wolves) was quite harsh and Joshua Smith didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
43' Luton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
42' Jacob Brown (Luton) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
42' Some neat passing and movement from Luton as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
39' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) receives a red card after his horrific challenge and is sent off!
37' Joshua Smith interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Albert Sambi Lokonga (Luton).
35' Joao Gomes (Wolves) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Joshua Smith blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
32' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
31' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
29' Wolves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
29' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Wolves will have a corner.
27' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Thomas Kaminski intercepts the ball.
25' Pedro Neto (Wolves) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is out of play. Luton will take a throw-in.
24' Amari'i Bell (Luton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Joshua Smith no option but to blow his whistle.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Luton.
21' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jacob Brown (Luton). The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Luton.
21' An attempted cross from Issa Kabore (Luton) is cleared. The ball has crossed the sideline. Luton are taking a throw-in.
20' Craig Dawson (Wolves) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Joshua Smith blows his whistle for an infringement.
18' Mario Lemina (Wolves) sends a long ball in, but Thomas Kaminski comfortably gathers the ball.
17' Jose Sa pulls off a decent save! Jacob Brown (Luton) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.
16' A pass by Amari'i Bell (Luton) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Wolves.
13' Jose Sa (Wolves) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
11' Carlton Morris (Luton) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the right post. A few inches to the left and it could have been a sweet goal!

9' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. The ball is behind the touchline and Wolves will take a throw-in.
8' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) sends a cross into the box, but Jose Sa comes off his line to gather the ball.
6' Luton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
5' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Luton have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Joao Gomes (Wolves) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
3' Joao Gomes (Wolves) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
3' Marvelous Nakamba (Luton) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. It's a throw-in for Luton.
1' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
Luton will kick the game off.
Joshua Smith was nominated as the referee for this game.
